partition_equation: patient_rows = valid + missing + invalid + unrepresentable + failed

records.validity: Existing explicit link retains its number; eligible new patient receives exactly one commit-time allocation.
records.missing: No committed allocation/mapping for a supposedly successful new patient.
records.remediation: Migration allocator/crosswalk correction only; never Classic key/OPD.

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL varchar(191); operational max 100
records.normalization: decode latin1, Unicode NFC, trim/collapse comparison whitespace; preserve protected original
records.validity: Independently evidenced first-name component, nonblank, <=100, valid encoding.
records.missing: Combined source name blank and no remediation.
records.unrepresentable: Populated combined name without reliable component evidence.

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL varchar(191); operational max 100
records.validity: Independently evidenced last-name component, nonblank, <=100, valid encoding.
records.missing: Combined source name blank and no remediation.
records.unrepresentable: Populated combined name without reliable component evidence.

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL date; operational before today
records.validity: Full nonzero DOB before cutover and not after DATE(RegDate); 1900-01-01 is a conservative Phase 2C quarantine gate, not an approved final historical lower bound.
records.invalid: unparseable/future, after registration, or below the conservative gate pending approved lower-bound policy
records.unrepresentable: partial/unknown date without approved target representation
records.release: evidenced correction and approved historical lower-bound rule; never generated date

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL; application enum male|female
records.release: evidenced correction or exact approved crosswalk

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL; operational max 20 and configured GH regex
records.normalization: versioned phone rule; preserve protected raw; no identity matching
records.validity: Exact configured target-compatible local/international representation after evidence-backed normalization.
records.unrepresentable: multiple numbers/extensions or country semantics not safely derivable
records.release: refreshed privacy-safe partition and evidenced correction

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL varchar(191), default active; service-only state vocabulary/coherence
records.validity: Explicit approved state jointly coherent with active/temporary/merge/deceased fields.
records.missing: no approved source derivation or state policy
records.invalid: DB default, convenient default, unsupported value or incoherent independent mapping
records.unrepresentable: all new source patients under the Phase 2C baseline

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL tinyint(1), default 1; service coherence with status
records.validity: Explicit approved boolean derived jointly with status.
records.missing: no approved source derivation or state policy
records.invalid: silent DB default or value incoherent with status
records.unrepresentable: all new source patients under the Phase 2C baseline

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL tinyint(1), default 0; temporary identities have service-only rules
records.validity: Explicit approved boolean; temporary identity never bypasses required identity.
records.missing: no approved source derivation or state policy
records.invalid: silent DB default or temporary placeholder used to bypass quarantine
records.unrepresentable: all new source patients under the Phase 2C baseline

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL varchar(20), default ACTIVE; service uses ACTIVE|MERGED without DB coherence check
records.validity: Explicit approved value coherent with merge pointer/history and zero automatic merges.
records.missing: no approved source derivation or state policy
records.invalid: silent DB default, inferred merge state or inconsistency with merge fields
records.unrepresentable: all new source patients under the Phase 2C baseline
records.release: approved coherent state matrix with zero automatic merges

records.target_constraint: DB NOT NULL tinyint(1), default 0; service coherence with status/death fields
records.normalization: approved coherent patient-state matrix and source-evidence rule only
records.validity: Explicit approved boolean jointly coherent with status and source-evidenced death facts.
records.missing: no approved source derivation or state policy
records.invalid: silent false default, invented life/death fact or incoherent state
records.unrepresentable: all new source patients under the Phase 2C baseline
records.release: approved coherent state matrix and source-evidence rule
